rationale: Class 1 repeated single-cell review of C107 negative cost rows. The raw SOI confirms that most flagged negative costs are source-presented as parenthetical Amortized Cost values, so those rows are not data errors. However, three flagged rows are source-grounded extraction errors: the stored negative cost equals the source Fair Value while the source Amortized Cost cell is a dash. Those localized column-value defects make the reviewed bundle a real_error. No aggregate anchor was needed.
